goal: Build muxFinder, a macOS menu bar app that finds tmux sessions on the user's Macs and attaches them in iTerm2 via tmux -CC.

phases.title: Package skeleton, process runner, quoting and validation
phases.summary: Sets up the Swift package, a safe process runner, shell quoting, input validation, app paths and a diagnostics log.

phases.title: tmux discovery: probe, parser, identity, error classification
phases.summary: Lists tmux sessions on a host with a read-only probe, parses them strictly and classifies SSH and tmux failures.

phases.title: Native iTerm2 API client
phases.summary: Talks to iTerm2 over its Unix-socket WebSocket API; split into 3a (wire layer) and 3b (transport and client), both done.

phases.title: iTerm2 wire layer: protobuf codec, typed messages, golden fixtures
phases.summary: Encodes and decodes the iTerm2 API protobuf messages muxFinder needs, checked byte-for-byte against golden fixtures.

phases.title: iTerm2 transport and client: WebSocket, cookie, API client, probe
phases.summary: Connects to iTerm2 over its Unix-socket WebSocket with a cookie and exposes the API calls to the app and probe.

phases.title: Integration proof, local: attach, native tabs and splits, detach, reattach
phases.summary: Proves the local attach workflow end to end; split into 4a (launch layer), 4b (coordinator) and 4c (real proof), all done.

phases.title: Launch layer and helper: request files, guard, muxfinder-launch
phases.summary: Hands attach requests to a launch helper through private files and checks the session is unchanged before attaching.

phases.title: Attach coordinator and probe commands
phases.summary: Attaches, confirms, focuses and detaches a local session in iTerm2, with hermetic tests and the e2e-local harness.

phases.title: Real local proof
phases.summary: Runs e2e-local against real iTerm2 and tmux; four passing runs, a 10 s helper lifetime, and the final integration proof.

phases.title: Integration proof over SSH, and existing-attachment detection
phases.summary: Proves SSH attach and existing-attachment detection; split into 5a (local detection and focus) and 5b (remote attach), both done.

phases.title: Existing-attachment detection, local
phases.summary: Maps iTerm2 tmux connections to sessions, focuses an existing attachment instead of opening a tab, and detaches by session.

phases.title: Remote attach over SSH
phases.summary: Attaches remote sessions in iTerm2 over ssh -t with a 20 s still-waiting budget; e2e-remote passed 11/11 twice on the final tree.

phases.title: Session operations: create, move here, disappeared sessions
phases.summary: Creates sessions, moves attached sessions here and handles vanished ones; split into 6a and 6b, both done.

phases.title: New session and vanished sessions
phases.summary: Creates sessions safely and reports vanished ones; e2e-local 15/15 and e2e-remote 16/16 passed on the final tree.

phases.title: Move here
phases.summary: Move here detaches other clients only on explicit confirmation; e2e-remote 17/17 and e2e-local 16/16 passed on the final tree.

phases.title: Host configuration and refresh engine
phases.summary: Stores hosts and refreshes their sessions; split into 7a (host configuration) and 7b (refresh engine), both done.

phases.title: Host configuration
phases.summary: Saves hosts.json safely with backups of anything it replaces, enforces one This Mac and suggests SSH config hosts.

phases.title: Refresh engine
phases.summary: Refreshes every host concurrently with backoff, sleep and wake handling, and live or stale snapshots.

phases.title: Menu bar app and popover
phases.summary: Menu bar popover shows hosts, sessions, statuses and badges; signed app bundle and preview screenshots.

phases.title: Settings, onboarding, launch at login, diagnostics
phases.summary: Split into 9a (Settings window) and 9b (onboarding and SSH setup), both done.

phases.title: Settings window
phases.summary: Settings window with host editor, launch at login, diagnostics and fix-its; changed or unusable host files never overwritten silently.

phases.title: Onboarding and SSH setup
phases.summary: Onboarding window for a first launch and a Set up SSH in iTerm2 action that opens a plain ssh login tab.

phases.title: Attach UX: open, focus, new session, move here, detach
phases.summary: Split into 10a (attach UX in the app) and 10b (real self-tests), both done.

phases.title: Attach UX in the app
phases.summary: Opening, focusing, Move here, Detach and New session work in the popover, with self-test flags, proven by hermetic tests.

phases.title: Real self-tests
phases.summary: Both app self-tests passed against the real iTerm2 and local tmux, and quitting the app left the attached session running.

phases.title: Persistent Work profiles
phases.summary: Persistent Work profiles, split into 11a (core and helper), 11b (real runs) and 11c (Settings), all done.

phases.title: Profile core, helper mode and probe
phases.summary: Generates and installs the app-owned iTerm2 dynamic profile file and adds the helper profile mode with its nesting guard.

phases.title: Real profile runs
phases.summary: Real e2e-profile runs pass 14/14 locally and on Saturno; iTerm2 mirroring the profile into New Bookmarks is handled.

phases.title: Settings section and launch-time rewrite
phases.summary: Settings tab and host fields for persistent profiles; the app keeps its own installed profile file current and never creates it unasked.

phases.title: Packaging, documentation, acceptance run
phases.summary: Install and uninstall scripts, README, architecture and testing docs, and a fresh acceptance run are done; split into 12a and 12b.

phases.title: Scripts and documents
phases.summary: Install and uninstall scripts with a hermetic check, README, architecture doc, testing matrix and manual checklist are in place.

phases.title: Acceptance run
phases.summary: Every unit test, every e2e run locally and on Saturno, both self-tests and the clean build passed and are recorded in the testing matrix.

phases.title: Hide the launch tab once attached
phases.summary: Attaches hide the launch tab under Buried Sessions and bring it back on detach or failure; split into 13a, 13b and 13c.

phases.title: Client, helper and spike
phases.summary: Adds the iTerm2 bury request and the helper restore, and proves iTerm2 bury and restore behavior locally and on Saturno (D29).

phases.title: Coordinator, race and recovery
phases.summary: Buries confirmed launch tabs, undoes a bury that lands after the helper ended, and recovers buried tabs while the app runs (hermetic).

phases.title: Real runs and documents
phases.summary: Coordinator bury proven for real: e2e-bury through the coordinator, self-tests assert the buried tab, all e2e runs pass, docs updated.

phases.title: Popover readability
phases.summary: Opaque popover with a bounded section per host, attach state per row, a readable badge, muted unreachable hosts and even footer spacing.

phases.title: Popover under the menu bar icon
phases.summary: Popover opens under the menu bar icon: diagnosed in I-1a, fixed in I-1b with muxFinder's own status item and panel.

phases.title: Diagnose: placement diagnostic and placement function
phases.summary: Adds a read-only placement diagnostic and a tested placement function; the far-right cause is inferred, the pre-fix frame unmeasured.

phases.title: Place the popover under the icon
phases.summary: muxFinder's own status item and panel open the popover under the icon, placed by PopoverPlacement (D30).

phases.title: New session: pick the directory
phases.summary: Picks the New session directory from recent, saved and session folders; split into I-2a and I-2b, both done.

phases.title: Directory store and session folders in discovery
phases.summary: Stores saved and recent directories and reports each session start folder from discovery.

phases.title: Directory picker UI and saved list in Settings
phases.summary: Adds the directory list to New session and a saved-directories editor in Settings, with keys and merging Save.

phases.title: Global hotkey: session switcher
phases.summary: Opens a keyboard-first session switcher from a user-recorded global hotkey; split into I-3a and I-3b, both done.

phases.title: Shortcut, storage, registrar and Settings recorder
phases.summary: Records a global shortcut in Settings, stores it in preferences.json and registers it system-wide through Carbon.

phases.title: Switcher panel
phases.summary: A centered switcher panel lists live sessions with search, opens one or creates a new session, and carries failures over.

phases.title: No empty Settings window at launch
phases.summary: The app launches with no stray SwiftUI Settings window, on a plain NSApplication with its own main menu; the shell check lists every window.

phases.title: Switcher: one click activates a row
phases.summary: A single click on a switcher row opens that session or shows the New session form, and a quick double click acts once.

phases.title: New session: Tab from Name to Directory
phases.summary: Tab and Shift-Tab move between the New session form fields in the popover and the switcher, the panels recalculating their key view loop.

phases.title: New session: typing in Directory filters the directory list
phases.summary: Typing in the New session Directory field filters the directory list, opening it while something matches.

phases.title: New session: change the host from the keyboard
phases.summary: With the Host picker focused, the panel leaves the arrows to it, so the keyboard can open the host menu and change the host.

phases.title: New session in its own always-on-top window, with folder drop
phases.summary: Split into I-9a (the model and the window) and I-9b (the folder drop, galleries and docs), both done.

phases.title: New session window: the model and the window
phases.summary: New session opens in its own floating titled window from the popover and the switcher, its state out of the shared panel.

phases.title: New session window: folder drop, galleries and docs
phases.summary: A single Finder folder dropped on New session's Directory fills its path; the window has a preview gallery, screenshots and checklist item.

phases.title: New session: search the host's folders by name
phases.summary: Spotlight folder search in New session, split into I-10a (core) and I-10b (UI), both done.

phases.title: Folder search core: script, channel, escaping, parser, probe
phases.summary: Static Spotlight script, folder-name query channel, escaping, bounded parser, scope preference and a folders probe; real runs here and on Saturno.

phases.title: Folder search UI: list section, setting, explanation, galleries
phases.summary: Folders on host section in the directory list, the home or whole-disk setting, Missing a folder? and galleries.

phases.title: Detach other clients
phases.summary: Detach other clients, split into I-11a (proof and core) and I-11b (the popover UI), both done.

phases.title: Detach other clients: real proof, coordinator call, e2e-detach-others
phases.summary: Real runs rejected attach-session -d; a checked per-client detach-client, the confirmed coordinator call and e2e-detach-others pass on both hosts.

phases.title: Detach other clients: popover item, confirmation, galleries, docs
phases.summary: Popover item Detach other clients with its offer rule, in-popover confirmation, result messages, refresh and row hint.

phases.title: Other terminal apps: Terminal.app and Ghostty
phases.summary: Lets muxFinder open sessions in Terminal.app and Ghostty with plain tmux; split into I-12a to I-12e, I-12a to I-12c done.

phases.title: Other terminals: proof and decision
phases.summary: Proves plain tmux confirmation, detach and Move here on both Macs and records D38; real Terminal and Ghostty runs are owed to the user.

phases.title: Other terminals: definitions, terminal seam, helper plain mode
phases.summary: Split into I-12b1, I-12b2 and I-12b3, all done: definitions, helper plain mode and the terminal seam.

phases.title: Other terminals: definitions, loader, AppleScript runner
phases.summary: Adds strict JSON terminal definitions with built-ins for Terminal and Ghostty, a safe loader and an AppleScript handler runner.

phases.title: Other terminals: helper plain mode, request terminal field, early report
phases.summary: Adds the helper attach-plain and profile-plain modes, the request terminal field and the early report file.

phases.title: Other terminals: terminal seam, iTerm2 backend, plain open/focus/close
phases.summary: Terminal seam: TerminalBackend protocol, iTerm2 adapter over the coordinator, plain window open, focus and close; nothing rewired yet.

phases.title: Other terminals: coordinator, confirmation, detection, e2e-plain
phases.summary: Coordinator for other terminals, split into I-12c1, I-12c2 and I-12c3.

phases.title: Other terminals, the plain backend
phases.summary: Plain backend behind the terminal seam: plain request, window open, evidence-only confirmation, tmux detach and move here.

phases.title: Other terminals, open on this Mac
phases.summary: Traces This Mac's tmux clients to the terminal app they run in, read-only; the plain backend focuses that app instead of opening a duplicate.

phases.title: Other terminals, onto the seam and real runs
phases.summary: Split into I-12c3a (the app, self-tests and probe onto the terminal seam) and I-12c3b (the plain e2e runs).

phases.title: Other terminals, onto the seam
phases.summary: Terminal setting, app, Settings, self-tests and probe one-offs moved onto the terminal seam; iTerm2 never contacted when not chosen.

phases.title: Other terminals, the plain runs
phases.summary: e2e-plain harness for Terminal and Ghostty behind the permission gate, tested hermetically; real plain runs owed, iTerm2 e2e regression passes.

phases.title: Other terminals: Settings, strings, onboarding, galleries
phases.summary: Adds the Terminal setting, strings that follow the chosen terminal, onboarding without iTerm2 and persistent work commands.

phases.title: Other terminals: documentation
phases.summary: Documents plain mode, adding a terminal, later candidates and the extended safety rules.

phases.title: Update check against GitHub releases
phases.summary: Tells the user about a newer GitHub release and updates the app in one click after verifying it; to be split a core / b UI.
